tech.name: fonts work in Google Sheets and Excel

coverage.note: One .xlsx (19 tabs, 210 KB); title says 'Google Sheets and Excel', hero label reads GOOGLE SHEETS AND EXCEL, description names Excel 2019+, M365, Excel for the web.
12 undated tabs January-December, income cell, 4-column log (80 rows, category dropdown =Categories on D7:D86), budget/spent/left/used with text bar; Fun 120% bar orange and -$20.00 red in January.

Year by month (income, spent, left over, saved and debt paid), share to savings and debt 9% (350/3900 checked), spending by category, pie by group and bar by month; Feb-Dec blank because income only shows when COUNT(log)>0.

Weekly / every 2 weeks / twice a month / monthly dropdown, each payday with bills due before next payday and what is left; verified $1,661.54 = 3600*12/26, Jan 1 bills 1400+95=1495, Jun 18 row 1815.99 -> -$154.45; 54 payday rows covers 53 weekly paydays.

Bills: due day, amount, Yes/No autopay, 12 month check columns with a check dropdown. Debt: Snowball/Avalanche, pay order, months and interest at minimum (checked NPER: store card 18 mo / $96.12, extra 5 mo / $68.45 saved). Savings: progress bar and save per month (checked 3800/14 = 271.43).

coverage.where: start + subtitle row 2 on all 19 tabs
coverage.note: Start here has 5 steps, Ready check, fix list and tip; every screenshot shows a one-line subtitle under the tab title.

Every cell with content is Arial (only hidden helper cols T:W on Start here are Calibri); one navy 1F2A44 header; white boxed evergreen inputs; widths 12-60; freeze panes set on every tab. Grey sheet stops at column U / row 139 (see visual).
Colour key on Start here, 4-column log with dropdown, January example of 11 entries, Ready check with plain-words To do; no white cell is locked.
Exact route Etsy.com > Purchases on a computer, Drive > New > File upload > open with Google Sheets, or double-click for Excel; FAQ covers phone app and browser preview.

Tab per month, 30 category rows (Setup E10:E39), 80 log rows a month, Paycheck plan; listing says 'Made for a personal or household budget in one currency' and 'Not for: ... bank syncing or automatic imports, business bookkeeping'.

File opens on Start here (first and active tab), 5 numbered steps, Ready check, 12-month jump grid; step 4 covers mid-year (empty months stay out) and Oct-Dec buyers (set Year to this year, fresh download in January).

coverage.where: start (Ready check, If something looks wrong); listing.description 'Questions buyers ask'
coverage.note: In-file parts are there (formula E17 names count and first month of bad categories); but the FAQ has 5 questions (phone app, browser preview, access, change category, locked cells) and none is 'which app' or 'Google vs Excel' as the brief promised (those answers sit only in 'Works with').

Functions used: IF, SUMIFS, SUMPRODUCT, COUNTIFS, NPER, EDATE, REPT, TEXT, CHOOSE, MATCH, INDEX, WEEKDAY, TODAY etc., all in both apps; Arial; works-with / not-for lines name Numbers and LibreOffice as not tested and say set up on a computer.

Photos are real tab renders captioned with tab names (2 and 8 are text info panels, not mockups); description lists all 19 tabs, says .xlsx not a link, USD with unprotect to change format, no video, no bank syncing.

coverage.note: All 19 sheets protected with no password; only unlocked formulas are intentional overridable defaults (month income H6, Paycheck C6/C8/paycheck column). Summaries read Setup!E10:E39; no #REF!/#VALUE!/#NAME? in any shot.
Category names, groups, budgets, income, bills, debts, goals and log cells unlocked; Tip gives Review > Unprotect Sheet and Data > Protect sheets and ranges; FAQ 'Can I change the locked cells?'.
Core is Setup, this month, Dashboard; Bills/Paycheck/Debt/Savings labelled extras 'use them when you want them'; 19 tabs, 12 identical month layouts; one-line subtitles.
Price 22, launch_sale 40% for 30 days (sale price 13.20); all modules in one file, no upsell seen.
Six Done/To do rows plus split info '67% needs, 13% wants, 20% savings and debt (50/30/20 guide)' (checked 2615/505/780 of 3900); each To do formula says what to fix and where.

11 example entries in January drive summary, Fun over-budget warning, bars and Dashboard charts; step 2 says select the white Date to Amount cells and press Delete; Ready check shows Example cleared To do.
Total budget $3,900.00, Left to budget $0.00 (sample balanced); conditional format turns G41 orange-red when below 0; Ready check row 'Every dollar has a job' repeats it in words.

Navy 1F2A44 headers, evergreen 2F6F5E step numbers, bars and input borders, white boxed inputs on solid E2E2E2 fill (50,769 cells); no pastels or clipart. Listing photos alternate navy and light-grey backgrounds, not only navy and white.

text.closest: Annual & Monthly Budget for Couples Spreadsheet Google Sheets and Excel | Dual Income Planner, Shared Bills, Savings and Debt Tracker

visual.issue: The #E2E2E2 sheet colour is a cell fill on A1:U139 only (gridlines off), so past column U or row 139 every tab turns plain white; a buyer who scrolls down or right in Sheets/Excel sees a hard grey/white edge. This is the reviewer's requested change, so fill whole columns/rows (or a much larger range).
visual.where: all 19 tabs (e.g. January A140, V1 have no fill)

visual.issue: Spreadsheet text in the listing photos is small at Etsy zoom (r013): the hero dashboard, January, Paycheck and the Debt panel on the extras photo render body text around 12-14 px on a 2000 px image.
Dashboard category list has a blank gap between Retirement and Credit card because row 23 is 34 pt tall (shared with the Group table header on the left).
Large empty grey band between the pie chart and the bar chart, and the bar chart sits far down the tab.
Start here uses only the left 60% of the width; the right side is empty grey, and step rows 2 and 3 are spaced tighter than 1, 4 and 5.
Colour key shows 'Calculated' inside a boxed cell, which contradicts 'plain cells calculate'.
Nav link row spacing is uneven and differs per tab (e.g. wide gap before Months on Start here, Bills on Dashboard), because links sit in columns of different widths.
About 27 white boxed Paycheck cells below the last payday have no payday next to them; they look like inputs that do nothing for every-2-weeks pay.
Listing photo backgrounds alternate navy (1,3,5,7) and light grey gradient (2,4,6,8) while the look brief says photos sit on navy and white.

notes: Round 4 (last allowed) open item: listing FAQ lacked 'which app' and 'Google vs Excel'. Both answers were added to the listing after round 4 and not re-checked by a fresh checker.
